ops.value: The honest picture: it is overnight, on your feet the whole shift, lifting cases up to 40 pounds, and the back room is cold in winter. You will work with a small team of five, mostly unloading two trucks a night, then filling the shelves aisle by aisle, then facing everything before the doors open at seven. Breaks are at midnight and three. The supervisor walks the floor at two. Pay is $17.50 an hour, plus $1.50 an hour for nights, paid every week, and there is overtime most weeks in November and December.
